messages:
jamie: Huge shoutout to Priya for the onboarding playbook + demo notes. customer sandbox went flawlessly this morning thanks to that doc. :sparkles:
priya: thanks! big team effort — Marco's triage checklist made the runbook actually usable under pressure. couldn't have done it alone. :muscle:
marco: we all chipped in. shoutout to Li for the quick sample data patch too, that stopped the notebook from erroring out. :raised_hands:
li: small patch, big win. glad it helped the customer finish the hands-on.
rachel: can we get a quick spotlight in the weekly all-hands? these cross-team docs save so much time for new accounts.
jamie: yes please — nominating @priya, @marco, and @li for the Spotlight award. blurb: "Streamlined onboarding docs + rapid triage led to zero friction during a live customer workshop."
priya: omg honored. we should also drop a few e-gift cards for the folks who stayed late — i'll coordinate amounts if leadership 👍
marco: i'll send links to the triage checklist and the notebook fixes into #docs-playbooks after lunch. consider it committed.
ci-bot: Playbook PR #472 merged by @marco at 09:14. Notebook patch deployed to staging at 09:21. :white_check_mark:
li: i'll help with the PR notes and add a short how-to video snippet for the notebook flow. video should make future demos smoother.
rachel: love that. remote folks who helped — please DM Priya shipping or e-gift preferences. i'll put the spotlight blurb in the all-hands agenda.
jamie: thank you all. small acts that keep customers smiling. :clap:
